  25  @boundscheck(False)
  26  @wraparound(False)
  27  @cdivision(True)
  28  def point_chisq_code(numpy.ndarray[REALTYPE, ndim=1] chisq,
  29                       numpy.ndarray[COMPLEXTYPE, ndim=1] v1,
  30                       int n, int slen,
  31                       numpy.ndarray[REALTYPE, ndim=1] shifts,
  32                       numpy.ndarray[numpy.uint32_t, ndim=1] bins,
  33                       int blen):
  34      # Do I need to declare UINT vs INT??
  35      cdef int num_parallel_regions, bstart, bend, i, j, k, r, start, end
  36      cdef REALTYPE *outr
  37      cdef REALTYPE *outi
  38      cdef REALTYPE *pr
  39      cdef REALTYPE *pi
  40      cdef REALTYPE *vsr
  41      cdef REALTYPE *vsi
  42      cdef REALTYPE *outr_tmp
  43      cdef REALTYPE *outi_tmp
  44      cdef COMPLEXTYPE v
  45      cdef REALTYPE vr, vi, t1, t2, k1, k2, k3, vs, va
  46  
  47      num_parallel_regions = 1
  48  
  49      outr = <REALTYPE *> malloc(n * sizeof(REALTYPE))
  50      outi = <REALTYPE *> malloc(n * sizeof(REALTYPE))
  51      pr = <REALTYPE *> malloc(n * sizeof(REALTYPE))
  52      pi = <REALTYPE *> malloc(n * sizeof(REALTYPE))
  53      vsr = <REALTYPE *> malloc(n * sizeof(REALTYPE))
  54      vsi = <REALTYPE *> malloc(n * sizeof(REALTYPE))
  55      outr_tmp = <REALTYPE *> malloc(n * sizeof(REALTYPE))
  56      outi_tmp = <REALTYPE *> malloc(n * sizeof(REALTYPE))
  57  
  58      for r in range(blen):
  59          bstart = bins[r] # int
  60          bend = bins[r+1] # int
  61          blen = bend - bstart # int
  62  
  63          #outr = numpy.zeros(n, dtype=real_type)
  64          #outi = numpy.zeros(n, dtype=real_type)
  65          for i in range(n):
  66              outr[i] = 0.
  67              outi[i] = 0.
  68  
  69  
  70          # CAN WE MAKE THIS LOOP PARALLEL?!
  71          for k in range(num_parallel_regions):
  72              start = blen * k / num_parallel_regions + bstart # uint
  73              end = blen * (k + 1) / num_parallel_regions + bstart # uint
  74  
  75              # start the cumulative rotations at the offset point
  76              #pr = numpy.zeros(n, dtype=real_type)
  77              #pi = numpy.zeros(n, dtype=real_type)
  78              #vsr = numpy.zeros(n, dtype=real_type)
  79              #vsi = numpy.zeros(n, dtype=real_type)
  80              #outr_tmp = numpy.zeros(n, dtype=real_type)
  81              #outi_tmp = numpy.zeros(n, dtype=real_type)
  82  
  83              for i in range(n):
  84                  pr[i] = cos(2 * 3.141592653 * shifts[i] * (start) / slen)
  85                  pi[i] = sin(2 * 3.141592653 * shifts[i] * (start) / slen)
  86                  vsr[i] = cos(2 * 3.141592653 * shifts[i] / slen)
  87                  vsi[i] = sin(2 * 3.141592653 * shifts[i] / slen)
  88                  outr_tmp[i] = 0
  89                  outi_tmp[i] = 0
  90  
  91              for j in range(start, end): # uint
  92                  v = v1[j]
  93                  vr = v.real
  94                  vi = v.imag
  95                  vs = vr + vi;
  96                  va = vi - vr;
  97  
  98                  for i in range(n):
  99                      t1 = pr[i]
 100                      t2 = pi[i]
 101  
 102                      # Complex multiply pr[i] * v
 103                      k1 = vr * (t1 + t2)
 104                      k2 = t1 * va
 105                      k3 = t2 * vs
 106  
 107                      outr_tmp[i] += k1 - k3
 108                      outi_tmp[i] += k1 + k2
 109  
 110                      # phase shift for the next time point
 111                      pr[i] = t1 * vsr[i] - t2 * vsi[i]
 112                      pi[i] = t1 * vsi[i] + t2 * vsr[i]
 113  
 114              # WHAT DOES THIS MEAN?? : pragma omp critical
 115              for i in range(n):
 116                  outr[i] += outr_tmp[i]
 117                  outi[i] += outi_tmp[i]
 118  
 119  
 120          for i in range(n):
 121              chisq[i] += outr[i]*outr[i] + outi[i]*outi[i]
 122  
 123      free(outr)
 124      free(outi)
 125      free(pr)
 126      free(pi)
 127      free(vsr)
 128      free(vsi)
 129      free(outr_tmp)
 130      free(outi_tmp)

 132  def chisq_accum_bin_numpy(chisq, q):

 135  def chisq_accum_bin(chisq, q):
 136      chisq = numpy.array(chisq.data, copy=False)
 137      q = numpy.array(q.data, copy=False)
 138      N = len(chisq)
 139      chisq_accum_bin_cython(chisq, q, N)

 141  def shift_sum(v1, shifts, bins):
 142      real_type = real_same_precision_as(v1)
 143      shifts = numpy.array(shifts, dtype=real_type)
 144  
 145      bins = numpy.array(bins, dtype=numpy.uint32)
 146      blen = len(bins) - 1 #
 147      v1 = numpy.array(v1.data, copy=False)
 148      slen = len(v1)
 149      n = int(len(shifts))
 150  
 151      # Create some output memory
 152      chisq = numpy.zeros(n, dtype=real_type)
 153  
 154      point_chisq_code(chisq, v1, n, slen, shifts, bins, blen)
 155  
 156      return  chisq
